title: Don't chase price. Wait for this. #smc #trading
description:
Fair Value Gap is the the key concept.

#smc #trading #daytrading #fvg
spoken_transcript:
Kind: captions
Language: en
Let's break down this winning trade
step-by-step.
The market is clearly in a downtrend.
Price keeps making lower lows and lower
highs. First, we mark the most recent
low. After reaching that low, price
starts to range. It moves sideways and
hesitates. This tells us that the market
is deciding what to do next.
Then, price breaks above the high of the
range. But, that alone does not mean the
trend has turned bullish. For a real
shift in structure, we need price to
break the last lower high. And here it
is. Price breaks above that lower high
and leaves behind a clean fair value
gap. That is our confirmation that
buyers are taking control.
Now, we do not chase the move. We simply
wait for price to retrace into the gap.
As soon as price closes into the gap, we
enter long.
This is one of the many high-probability
setups that smart money concepts allows
you to identify and trade with
precision.
